text:
Residents:
Felix (30s) and Aisha (40s) work in town offices. Weekdays: out ~08:00–17:30, home evenings. Weekends: sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day. Felix hobbies: family calls, knitting, movies. Aisha hobbies: family calls, movies, houseplants, running.

Object Locations (Fri 23:59):
Balcony: Floor has watering can. Table has spray bottle, gardening gloves.
Bathroom: Shelf has detergent, laundry basket. Med cabinet has Aisha’s meds, Felix’s skincare/toiletry bag. Sink has soap, toothbrush holder, Felix’s razor, Aisha’s razor. Rack has towels for both.
Bedroom 1: Floor has ironing board. Desk has Aisha’s laptop, Felix’s charger, Felix’s headphones, Felix’s laptop, Aisha’s headphones, Aisha’s notebook, Aisha’s pen. Dresser has Felix’s hair dryer. Nightstand has books, Aisha’s book, Aisha’s glasses, Aisha’s tablet, Felix’s phone, Aisha’s phone. Bed has Aisha’s tablet. Wardrobe empty.
Entry: Floor has toolbox, Felix’s umbrella, vacuum. Hook has Felix’s backpack, Aisha’s backpack, Felix’s jacket, Felix’s scarf, Aisha’s jacket, Aisha’s scarf. Table has Felix’s keys, Felix’s wallet, Aisha’s keys, Aisha’s wallet. Shoe rack has Aisha’s shoes, Felix’s shoes.
Kitchen: Counter has cutting board, kettle, knives, toaster, Felix’s vitamins, clock, pan. Cupboard has duster, Aisha’s mug, Felix’s mug, Felix’s lunchbox, plates, Aisha’s bowl, Felix’s bowl. Drawer has spatula, kitchen knife. Table has fruit bowl. Pantry has shopping bag. Sink has bowls, Aisha’s glass, Aisha’s bowl, Aisha’s mug. Dish rack has Felix’s water bottle. Chair/Floor empty.
Living: Armchair has cushion 2. Bookshelf has frame, speaker, vase. Coffee table has candle, coasters, tissues, remote, board game, Aisha’s glass, Aisha’s mug, serving dish, snack bowl. Couch has blanket, cushion 1, Felix’s knitting bag. Side table has lamp. TV stand has remote. Floor empty.
Office: All spots empty.

Notes:
Both residents leave for work around 08:00, taking personal items (phones, keys, wallets, bags, laptops, water bottles, outerwear, shoes) with them. They return around 17:30–19:00, placing these items back in the entryway (hooks, table, floor) or kitchen (water bottles). Felix’s work items (laptop, charger, headphones, jacket, scarf, keys, wallet, water bottle) are consistently moved to the entry floor/hook/table in the evening. Aisha’s work items (backpack, headphones, jacket, lunchbox, notebook, pen, scarf, water bottle) are moved to the entry hook/table/floor. Aisha’s keys and wallet remain on the entry table. Felix’s shoes stay on the shoe rack. Kitchen items (bowls, mugs, glasses) are moved from sink to cupboard/dish rack overnight. Shared kitchen tools (knife, pan, spatula) are moved to the counter in the evening, likely for cooking. Aisha moves her book, glasses, and tablet from the nightstand to the bed in the late evening. In the evening, both residents move work electronics (laptops, chargers, headphones, notebooks, pens) to the bedroom desk. In the late evening, they move snacks and drinks (board game, glasses, mugs, serving dishes) from the kitchen to the living room coffee table for movie time.
